classification_descriptions.riplay: Ringkasan Informasi Produk dan Layanan (RIPLAY) Versi Personal / Personal Product Summary and Services Information. Usually four pages of bilingual benefits, risks, FX simulation and disclaimers; final-page city/date, Petugas Bank and Nasabah signature blocks, Tanggal Cetak Dokumen, bottom-right initials on each page. This is a product disclosure, not a transaction application or invoice.
classification_descriptions.application: Bank application of transaction form. Payment type, transaction type, beneficiary, remitter, SWIFT, account, currency, exchange rate, charges and signatures.
classification_descriptions.lld: Laporan Lalu Lintas Devisa (LLD) form. Penerima dana and pembayar/pengirim sections, residence status, sandi negara, categories, identification codes, financial relationship and sandi transaksi.
classification_descriptions.invoice: Underlying commercial invoice. To/customer, From/company, invoice number and dates, item table with quantity, unit price, subtotal, final total and payment bank instructions.
classification_descriptions.valas_declaration_1: Surat Pernyataan Pembelian Valas 1, Diatas Jumlah Threshold. Above-threshold declaration with identity and NPWP, tujuan/tanggal/jumlah penggunaan, sumber/tanggal/jumlah penerimaan, signature and meterai.
classification_descriptions.valas_declaration_2: Surat Pernyataan Pembelian Valas 2, Paling Banyak Sebesar Jumlah Threshold. Threshold-limited declaration of currency bought, company/individual name and address, city/date, signatory and meterai.
classification_descriptions.ektp: Indonesian electronic KTP identity card. NIK of 16 digits, name, birthplace/date, gender, blood type, RT/RW, village/district, religion, citizenship, portrait and cardholder signature.
classification_descriptions.join_visit: Account Opening: Form Join Visit. Fields: Nama Nasabah, CIF, Tanggal Visit/Kunjungan, Nama Marketing Pembawa Form, Foto KTP Nasabah, Alamat KTP
classification_descriptions.edd: Account Opening: Form EDD. Fields: Pilihan jenis transaksi, Pilihan perorangan , Nama, Nomor CIF, Jenis Produk / Layanan Bank, Screening – DTTOT / DPPSPM
classification_descriptions.account_opening_form: Account Opening: Form Pembukaan Rekening. Fields: Jenis Formulir, Kantor Cabang, Tanggal, Status Nasabah, Saya memliki rekening di Bank Sinarmas, No Rekening Bank Sinarmas
classification_descriptions.signature_difference: Account Opening: Surat Pernyataan Beda Tanda Tangan. Fields: Nama, Nomor Identitas, Alamat Sesuai Identitas, Nomor Rekening, Tanda Tangan  1, Tanda Tangan 2
classification_descriptions.company_reference: Account Opening: Surat Referensi Perusahaan. Fields: Nama Perusahaan, Tanggal Surat, Nomor Surat, Tujuan Surat, Perihal, Nama Nasabah (disebutkan dalam surat)

valas_declaration_1: surat pernyataan pembelian valas 1 (diatas jumlah threshold)
valas_declaration_2: surat pernyataan pembelian valas 2 (paling banyak sebesar jumlah threshold)

forex_checkpoint_labels: Application / LLD beneficiary identity and address

set.notes: Compare corresponding party roles. Valas customer is the sender; beneficiary is independently checked by checkpoints 7 and 14.
set.label: Application sender must match the customer on the applicable Valas declaration; beneficiary consistency is checked separately.

set.notes: Require invoice number, matching buyer/sender and payee/beneficiary. An explicitly selected supporting invoice must match number, currency and total. The selected invoice payment amount and currency must also match LLD, consistently with checkpoint 11. Invoice numbers are never compared with money.
set.label: Invoice identity and corresponding buyer/beneficiary roles must link to the transaction.
